Independently reconstructed from the dual-confirmed ATT-0120 interface: Y is the atlas-independent reduced closed classifying-image closure, r_T is W_26(21) of ordinary restriction to U_Y, and T_Z=ker(r_T) is a pure weight -16 subobject of T. CLM-0120-7 and FND-0180 assert no Tate type, vanishing, cycle generation, or map from Z. Degree/weight/twist ledger 2*21-16=26 and 26-42=-16 is consistent with FND-0001.

Independently reconstructed peeling arithmetic, without treating ATT-0128 as dual-confirmed: for a smooth closed stratum of dimension n and codimension c=21-n in a smooth open of M_{6,6}, purity at ordinary degree 26 gives source degree 26-2c=2n-16 and remaining twist (-c)+(21)=n. For n>=17 one has 2n-16>n, so Artin/Andreotti-Frankel vanishing on an affine coarse space kills the term; for n<=7 the degree 2n-16 is negative; for n=8 the piece is a subquotient of H^0(S)(8), hence a finite direct sum of Q(8) by semisimplicity of polarizable pure Hodge structures. For 9<=n<=16 one has 2n-16<=n (equality at n=16, where Artin vanishing requires k>n), so those lowest-weight groups are not discharged. No verified map replaces them by a computation of ker(r_T).

The abelian-ninefold model is a product-space support X'=A x P^{12}, Y'=A x {pt}, not the ATT-0120 closed substack Y of M_{6,6}. No morphism of mixed Hodge structures from H^2(A)(9) to the named T_Z is constructed, and no nonzero image in T_Z is proved. Independently, Y' is proper, hence cannot be a single admissible affine peeling stratum. By the theorem's own disproof clause this is not an interface-surviving counterexample.

No class in the supplied material is proved both non-Tate as a Hodge structure and nonzero in ker(r_T). Atlas or family-base non-Tate classes are excluded by the theorem unless a nonzero target image through the verified interface is proved. The disproof criterion is therefore not met.

strongest_attack: Strongest attack: the assigned Tate conclusion itself, through the target-interface contract. ATT-0129 correctly names the dual-confirmed ATT-0120 kernel T_Z=ker(r_T) and uses only the constructed inclusion phi, but its survival_or_tate_argument is explicitly non-discharging. Independently reconstructed purity for a smooth pair of dimension n in the smooth 21-fold gives source degree 2n-16 and remaining twist n; Artin/Andreotti-Frankel vanishing on an affine coarse space applies only when 2n-16>n, i.e. n>=17, while n<=7 is negative degree and n=8 is H^0(S)(8). For 9<=n<=16 one has 2n-16<=n, so those graded pieces of the kernel filtration remain possible and are not shown Tate. Semisimplicity splits the pure weight -16 filtration as an actual Hodge-structure isomorphism, not merely after semisimplification, but that splitting cannot upgrade undetermined graded pieces to Q(8). Outcome: the attack succeeds against the theorem; verdict incomplete. Secondary attack, as a putative refutation: the FND-0191 abelian ninefold H^2(A)(9) is a product-model support, not Y, carries no proved nonzero image in this T_Z, and is proper so cannot be one affine peeling stratum; the theorem's disproof clause therefore excludes it, and the attack does not refute the attempt's audit claims. Remaining adversary-checklist attacks were attempted and do not convert incompleteness into refutation or into a proof: Q-coefficients throughout, no integral or coarse-moduli overreach beyond ordinary-cohomology comparison for Artin vanishing; Borel-Moore degree 16 versus ordinary degree 26 with Poincare twist (21) is consistent and is not silently replaced by compact-support degree 16; no forbidden Gysin for (M_{6,6},Z) and no extra Kunneth shift is used on the named kernel; no spectral-sequence differential is claimed; no graph-automorphism invariants-versus-coinvariants step appears; no predicted motive is treated as a theorem; pure Tate is not upgraded to algebraic or tautological generation; complementary stable-pair or assembly terms are correctly omitted. Evidence limitation: no external web evidence was used.
theorem_statement: Let T_Z be the canonical mixed-Hodge subquotient of T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) supplied by a verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE datum. Prove T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8). A disproof must exhibit a non-Tate subquotient of this named T_Z through the verified target interface; non-Tate cohomology of an arbitrary family base, atlas, product model, standalone Z, or a source class whose target image is not proved nonzero is not a disproof. This theorem does not itself assemble the complementary target terms.
